messages:
emma_support: Customer reports promo code `NEWYEAR24` returns "invalid/expired" when applying via API and web checkout. They say dashboard shows expiry 2025-01-15. Account id: acct_9876. Attached screenshot and curl output. Can someone triage? :eyes:
promo-bot: automated-log: redemption attempt for acct_9876 at 2025-01-02T18:12:03Z -> response 400 {"error":"code_expired","code":"NEWYEAR24"}
emma_support: Also customer says they tried both web form and `POST /v1/billing/promos/redeem` with same result.
sanjay_eng: OK I'll try repro. Can you paste the exact curl you used?
emma_support: Copied from customer:```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/promos/redeem -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"account_id":"acct_9876","code":"NEWYEAR24"}'```
sanjay_eng: repro locally against prod-ish cluster: got same 400. Looking at promo service logs now. Which partner/partner_id is the code tied to?
emma_support: Partner said this was issued via partner_zen. Promo metadata in dashboard (screenshot) shows "Expires: Jan 15 2025" but API fails.
lee_billing: Pulling promo DB: code NEWYEAR24 -> {status: active, partner: partner_zen, expires_at: 1736841600}. That epoch (1736841600) converts to 2025-01-15 UTC. DB row present. Hmm.
sanjay_eng: That suggests service layer eval differs. Dumping service cache and decision log for code check: `promo_service.decide(code, acct)` -> flagged as expired because `effective_expires_at` resolved to 0 for partner_zen codes after migration. Trace: migration job MIGRATE-PARTNER-CODES-2024 set `partner_metadata.version = 2` and missed `expires_override` column mapping.
tess_devex: Reproduced with a minimal script hitting promo-service directly (internal port):```python
resp = requests.post('http://promo-svc.internal/redeem', json={'account_id':'acct_9876','code':'NEWYEAR24'})
print(resp.status_code, resp.json())
# -> 400 {"error":"code_expired","checked_expires_at":0}
```
sanjay_eng: Root cause: promo-service falls back to `expires_override` when partner metadata has `version==2`, but migration left `expires_override` NULL for many partner_zen codes. Null -> interpreted as 0 -> treated as epoch start -> expired. Admin dashboard reads `expires_at` directly from the promo table and displays correct human date, so admin view masked the issue.
lee_billing: Good find. Impact: ~430 partner_zen issued codes across partners; some will show valid on dashboard but fail redemption.
emma_support: Customer needs immediate resolution — can we grant the credit while fix is deployed?
sanjay_eng: I'll push a quick hotfix to promo-service: treat NULL `expires_override` as absent (do not coerce to 0). Patch ready, will deploy canary to staging then prod. Estimated ~20 min.
tess_devex: Meanwhile I can apply a manual account credit and mark the promo as used to avoid double-redemption. Doing manual credit of $50 to acct_9876 now.
lee_billing: Manual action logged in billing UI: credit_txn id tx_99234, note: manual grant due to backend expiry-bug.
sanjay_eng: Deploying patch to prod canary... :hourglass_flowing_sand:
sanjay_eng: Canary healthy, no regressions, rolling to remainder of promo-service.
sanjay_eng: Deployed. Re-tested redemption for acct_9876 -> 200 OK, redemption accepted, response: `{"redeemed_amount":50, "balance":50}`
emma_support: Customer notified and refund applied. They confirmed web checkout now accepts NEWYEAR24. :white_check_mark:
lee_billing: I'll schedule a backfill job to populate `expires_override` properly for partner_zen or remove reliance on that field. Ticket: INT-1319 created.
tess_devex: Follow-up: add a dashboard indicator when API/DB disagreement exists (suggested UX improvement). Filing as a low-priority product improvement.
emma_support: Closing this thread for now. Thanks team. :pray:
